invariants.name: prefix_xor_match_ones_suffix
invariants.description: In the loop over the binary representation of C, the XOR of the already constructed elements matches C on the prefix from the most significant bit down to the bit before the current index, while the suffix from the current index to the least significant bit consists entirely of 1s. This property is maintained by appending a block of 1s exactly when the current bit of C differs from the previous bit, and it guarantees both correctness and minimal array length.

invariants.name: all_ones_element
invariants.description: Every element placed into the array is of the form 2^k - 1, i.e., a number whose binary representation is a contiguous block of 1s.
